data.exact_reserve_text: The 2015 net technical result of GBP 24.0m (2014: GBP 48.6m) includes GBP 29.0m (2014: GBP 27.7m) of releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 571.241m at 1 January 2015. The report states a net release from prior accident years of GBP 29.0m (net of reinsurance), representing approximately a 5.1% release relative to opening gross claims reserves. The movement is described as releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years and is attributed to favourable claims development and reinsurance recoveries.
raw_causal_phrases: releases from reserves in respect of prior accident years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states a net release of GBP 29.0m for prior accident years (page 42). A gross prior-year movement (gross of reinsurance) was not clearly tabulated as a single 'movement in prior year provision' figure; a gross claims development table (gross triangle) is present but was not unambiguously convertible to a single gross prior-year movement within the time available. Therefore the reported prior_year_development_gbp_m uses the explicitly stated NET amount (flagged here). If a gross PYD is required, it should be calculated from the gross claims development table on page 43.
